thesis.title: COIN — Historical preliminary candidate: Q3 2024 top-line YoY screen pass (SEC-only, no price/valuation)
thesis.thesis: HISTORICAL PRELIMINARY CANDIDATE — NOT AN INVESTMENT CONCLUSION. On a frozen, offline SEC-source adapter, Coinbase Global, Inc. (COIN) passed the single screening rule applied: issuer-reported total revenue for Q3 2024 (period ended 2024-09-30, released 2024-10-30) of USD 1,205,193 thousand versus USD 674,148 thousand for Q3 2023, a derived YoY change of +78.8%, above the 20.0% minimum. This is a one-rule top-line growth observation only. It is not a seven-factor completeness screen, not a live quote, and not evidence of an attractive investment. The screen explicitly excludes share price, valuation, analyst targets, future returns, and current market data; no price or valuation input exists in this packet, so no valuation judgment can be formed here. Metric basis: issuer's own "total revenue" label (GAAP-basis condensed consolidated statements of operations plus shareholder-letter operating summary), in USD thousands, with YoY derived from the two reported periods rather than taken from a stated growth rate. Material counterpoint from a different supplied field: the same packet reports total revenue down 17% quarter-over-quarter and transaction revenue down 27% quarter-over-quarter, and net income of only ~USD 75 million (rounded) alongside a ~USD 121 million (rounded) pretax loss on the crypto investment portfolio. So the 78.8% YoY figure is a low-base comparison against a weak Q3 2023, while the sequential trend and the earnings quality in the same quarter point the other way. Discriminating follow-up question: is the QoQ revenue decline and the transaction-revenue contraction a seasonal/volatility-driven dip that reverses in the next reported quarter, or the start of a durable mix shift away from transaction fees — and does subscription-and-services revenue growth offset it? That question is not answerable from this packet and requires the next period's SEC disclosure. Boundary: no price, market cap, multiple, or expected return is asserted; no peer ranking on a common date is made; the basis warning notes issuer top-line labels differ (total revenue vs total net revenues) and must not be ranked against other issuers.
assumptions: The +78.8% YoY total revenue growth is measured against a depressed Q3 2023 base, so the rate overstates underlying momentum.
Issuer-reported 'total revenue' is the correct top-line label for COIN and is not comparable to issuers reporting 'total net revenues'.
The Q3 2024 figures are as reported in the Q3 2024 shareholder letter and condensed consolidated statements of operations; no restatement or subsequent-period revision is reflected in this packet.
No price, valuation, or market-cap input is available in this packet, so the screen pass carries no valuation implication.
catalysts: Next quarterly SEC disclosure (Q4 2024) showing whether the QoQ revenue decline reverses or continues.
Disclosure of subscription-and-services revenue mix versus transaction revenue, to test whether the transaction-fee contraction is structural.
Any issuer disclosure on crypto investment portfolio gains/losses that would change the earnings-quality picture.
invalidations: A subsequent SEC filing restating Q3 2024 or Q3 2023 total revenue such that derived YoY falls below 20%.
Evidence that the reported 'total revenue' label used here is not the issuer's top-line measure for the period.
Continued QoQ contraction in total and transaction revenue across subsequent reported periods, indicating the YoY growth was base-effect only.

# COIN — Historical SEC-Disclosure Candidate Research (US)

**Outcome: RETAINED on the single rule → one historical preliminary candidate thesis saved (`th_1d2d70707b3c4e6d9375`, status `researching`, conviction 2).**

## 1. Screen run and what it actually is
- Tool: `finance-tools__screen_stocks`, market US, symbols `["COIN"]`, `require_complete=false`.
- Adapter: `offline_frozen_adapter`, fixture `FINTECH-SEC-SCREEN-HOLDOUT-v1`, `not_live_market_data: true`, request `9d027e4a-fc4d-4324-b2f7-c0410f94e959`.
- Rule applied: **issuer-reported top-line revenue YoY ≥ 20.0%** — one rule only. It is **not** a seven-factor completeness screen and **not** a live quote. Excluded dimensions per the adapter: share price, valuation, analyst target, future return, current market data.
- Result: `passed: 1`, `failed: 0`, `rejected: []`, completeness 0.9737, no quality flags.

## 2. Retained item — reported fields
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Issuer | Coinbase Global, Inc. (COIN) |
| Period | Q3 2024, ended 2024-09-30 |
| Release date | 2024-10-30 |
| Top-line label | `total_revenue` (issuer's own label) |
| Q3 2024 total revenue | USD 1,205,193 thousand |
| Q3 2023 total revenue | USD 674,148 thousand |
| Derived YoY | **+78.8%** (derived from the two reported periods, not a stated rate) |
| Threshold | 20.0% → **pass** |
| Basis | GAAP condensed consolidated statements of operations + shareholder-letter operating summary |
| Source | https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1679788/000167978824000186/q324shareholderletter.htm |
| SHA-256 | `f9a2d60153fd79c6ac9f7dfcd80344995ffa4b121c336808b2e2f13968230a52` |
| Locators | Shareholder letter p.3 operating summary; Q3 2024 condensed consolidated statements of operations |
| Fact IDs | COIN-Q3-TOTALREV-2024, COIN-Q3-TOTALREV-2023, COIN-Q3-REV-QOQ, COIN-Q3-TRANREV-QOQ, COIN-Q3-NETINCOME, COIN-Q3-CRYPTOLOSS |

No criterion failed, so no rejection rationale is required.

## 3. Independent counterpoint (different supplied field)
The screen's pass rests on a **year-over-year** comparison. The same packet's **sequential** and **earnings** fields point the other way:
- Total revenue **−17% QoQ** (COIN-Q3-REV-QOQ).
- Transaction revenue **−27% QoQ** (COIN-Q3-TRANREV-QOQ) — the fee engine contracted sharply within the very quarter that shows +78.8% YoY.
- Net income only **~USD 75 million** (rounded) while carrying a **~USD 121 million** (rounded) **pretax loss on the crypto investment portfolio** (COIN-Q3-NETINCOME, COIN-Q3-CRYPTOLOSS) — i.e., the quarter's profit was small relative to a large mark-to-market drag.

Read together: the +78.8% is a comparison against a depressed Q3 2023 base, while the sequential trend and earnings quality in the same quarter are deteriorating. The screen rule cannot see any of this because it only looks at one YoY ratio.

## 4. Discriminating follow-up question
Is the QoQ revenue decline and the −27% transaction-revenue contraction a volatility/seasonality-driven dip that reverses next quarter, or the start of a durable mix shift away from transaction fees — and does subscription-and-services revenue growth offset it? **Not answerable from this packet**; it requires the next period's SEC disclosure.

## 5. Explicit boundaries
- **No price/valuation input exists in this packet.** No market cap, multiple, target price, or expected return is asserted, and none can be derived here. Passing this one rule says nothing about whether COIN is an attractive investment.
- **No peer ranking on a common date.** The adapter's basis warning notes issuer top-line labels differ (`total revenue` vs `total net revenues`); these rates must not be ranked across issuers, and no other issuer was screened in this run.
- **No trading, no live market tools** were used.
- **Packet vs filing:** the packet is a frozen offline extract. Absence of a field here is a packet omission, not an SEC filing omission — the underlying filing may contain more.
- `next_review_at` was deliberately omitted (no genuinely future-dated review was specified); the source dates 2024-09-30 / 2024-10-30 are recorded in evidence only.

## 6. What was persisted
Exactly one thesis, `th_1d2d70707b3c4e6d9375`, version 1, status `researching`, conviction 2, with the full source URL and SHA-256 in structured evidence, the key numbers, the counterpoint, the follow-up question, and the missing price/valuation boundary stated in the thesis text. `required_event_metrics` was set to the two revenue fields so a future event review cannot proceed on an incomplete packet.
